name: Split Happens
review:
Bowling on a 3x5 grid with 10 fixed lines that pay both ways. Walking stacked wilds and the Split Happens feature shake up the reels.

The walking wilds can keep a good spin going across several respins. High volatility with only a 3,000x cap is a tough combo, and the published RTP is 94.16%, below average. Fun theme, but check the numbers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
